svg.aria-label: Interactify on AWS EC2: a push to main auto-deploys the Next.js client to Vercel, and GitHub Actions tests the server, pushes a Docker image to Docker Hub, then SSHes into an EC2 instance that pulls and runs it. On EC2, nginx proxies WebSocket traffic to the server container, which publishes through Redis and sends writes through Kafka and Zookeeper to MongoDB Atlas.
svg.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: runs as the last CI step
What runs on the EC2 host
Only interactify-server is replaced on deploy; the other containers keep running.
